newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - PepsiCo Inc Q2 shr $0.42 vs $0.36.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - PepsiCo Inc Q2 shr $0.42 vs $0.36.

text.p: (All data above in millions except per share numbers)

NOTE: The 1997 second quarter includes a $0.02-a-share net gain. The quarter's unusual items were: A $500 million gain on the sale of PepsiCo food services to AmeriServe Food Distribution Inc; and charges to dispose of assets ($247 million), to improve snack foods productivity ($82 million), and to strenghten international bottler structure ($36 million). In all these items produced $32 million gain after tax, or $0.02 a share.
The 1997 six-month figures include the same unusual items, except that charges to dispose of assets totaled $225 million. This lead to an after-tax gain of $30 million, or $0.02 a share.
The 1996 six-month figures include charges to dispose of assets totaling $26 million, for an after-tax charge of $17 miliion, or $0.01 a share.
The company's full name is PepsiCo Inc
